name: Birder Shona

intro.text: Shh! Red-throated diver on the lochan. If you scare it off, I'll never forgive you. Let's battle quietly.

after: Divers are called 'loons' in North America. In Shetland they call the red-throated diver the 'rain goose', because its wailing is said to forecast rain. Up here that's not much of a forecast.
